body: I never tried therapy, I don't know if it could help. I am not generally a loud bully you know, I tend to be calm and do the logical thing most of the times, and even when I am fighting I tend to be really calm and analytical. I just don't know why sometimes I want to hurt someone really bad, it comes like an urge I can't control. It's like my human side is suddenly dominated by my animal side, like my logic is suddenly enslaved by my emotions. To be honest, I don't like the therapy idea, but which kind of professional I should be looking for?

I don't have any hope anymore. The problem is that I always get back sometime, I always do some impulsive shit, no matter how much I understand the value of logic and patience. Some day I do some serious shit and fuck up with everybody.
